{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely easy to use with a low learning curve, even for new users.",
    "Simple, predictable flat-rate pricing that is excellent value for money.",
    "Great for clear team communication and project organization with a focused toolset.",
    "Straightforward interface that avoids feature bloat and complexity.",
    "Efficient for managing small to medium-sized projects and teams.",
    "Reliable and stable performance due to its focused feature set."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options compared to highly flexible competitors.",
    "Lacks advanced features, reporting, and complex automations for larger, intricate projects.",
    "Fewer third-party integrations than other platforms, which can be restrictive.",
    "Scalability challenges for very large organizations or complex workflows.",
    "Project-level reporting and analytics capabilities are basic, and global overviews are not suitable for deep insights.",
    "Can feel restrictive for users who prefer highly tailored environments."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Project-level reporting and analytics capabilities are basic, and global overviews are not suitable for deep insights. (Justified by: [friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.)"
  ]
}

pros: Extremely easy to use with a low learning curve, even for new users.
Simple, predictable flat-rate pricing that is excellent value for money.
Great for clear team communication and project organization with a focused toolset.
Straightforward interface that avoids feature bloat and complexity.
Efficient for managing small to medium-sized projects and teams.
Reliable and stable performance due to its focused feature set.
cons: Limited customization options compared to highly flexible competitors.
Lacks advanced features, reporting, and complex automations for larger, intricate projects.
Fewer third-party integrations than other platforms, which can be restrictive.
Scalability challenges for very large organizations or complex workflows.
Project-level reporting and analytics capabilities are basic, and global overviews are not suitable for deep insights.
Can feel restrictive for users who prefer highly tailored environments.
changed: Project-level reporting and analytics capabilities are basic, and global overviews are not suitable for deep insights. (Justified by: [friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.)
